original_assumption: Use roughly 45k-57k as a narrow current sensitivity range.
observed_problem: The band combines different years and category systems: prefectural totals vary historically, post-2011 combined counts were not provided, and the undated Marine Corps component subtotal is not a closed total.
revised_rule: Retain historical and scope-specific population rows separately; do not publish a current per-capita result until one same-year, same-definition denominator is closed.
impact_on_outputs: PD002 is ineligible; PD009 records the missing current denominator; W2C-A017 is an explicit null anchor.
requires_principal_decision: yes; only if the principal later approves a new denominator source and definition

original_assumption: Treat the official 'approaches 80,000' statement as the broad upper value of a population interval.
observed_problem: The same undated page names rounded components totaling about 57,100 and does not identify the residual to 80,000.
revised_rule: Store 80,000 and each named component separately; keep the 57,100 arithmetic subtotal as a diagnostic, not a population estimate.
impact_on_outputs: W2C-A002-A007 and PD003-PD004 separate broad text, components and arithmetic.

original_assumption: Use installation and service-provider counts to fill the missing islandwide denominator.
observed_problem: USNH beneficiaries, Camp Butler population served, Team Kadena and dispersed USAG Okinawa use different categories, have no common observation date and can overlap.
revised_rule: Treat each as a scope-specific service or installation scale marker; never sum across them without an explicit crosswalk.
impact_on_outputs: W2C-A008-A016 and PD005-PD008 remain case-specific and overlap-flagged.

original_assumption: Merge Earthjustice USD 276,345.50 and Treasury USD 280,000 as one rounded case payment.
observed_problem: They are different official record types with a USD 3,654.50 difference and no source explaining the accounting relationship.
revised_rule: Preserve both facts and a derived unreconciled-difference row; make no fees/costs/interest/timing explanation.
impact_on_outputs: W2C-A020-A022 remain separate and cannot generate a simple funding edge.
requires_principal_decision: yes if later evidence proposes a reconciliation

original_assumption: Use JPY 648.3bn as a Ministry-confirmed cumulative expenditure anchor.
observed_problem: In the official transcript the figure appears in the reporter's question; the minister's answer confirms only the December 2019 JPY 930bn rough estimate.
revised_rule: Classify JPY 648.3bn as a reporter premise pending closure against an official spending table.
impact_on_outputs: W2C-A041 is not eligible as confirmed expenditure and cannot support a spent/estimate ratio.
requires_principal_decision: yes if an official cumulative table is later found

original_assumption: Treat JPY 930bn as budget or expenditure and compare it directly with NGO or litigation amounts.
observed_problem: The official language is a December 2019 rough total estimate that may change; annual budget basis and contract basis are separate accounting views.
revised_rule: Keep rough estimate, component estimates, annual budget lines and contract-basis lines distinct; use them only as system-scale context.
impact_on_outputs: W2C-A030-A045 carry separate amount semantics and explicit prohibited inferences.

original_assumption: Interpret the 13 positive-entry episodes and underlying_change=yes 0 as the distribution of all accountability action outcomes.
observed_problem: ENTRY and RECORD were selection conditions; four episodes remain event-fact candidates; no matched non-entry cases or systematic project-change counterexample search has been completed.
revised_rule: Freeze three frames: 13 positive entries, matched non-entry search, and project-change counterexample search; recode results on parallel axes before inference.
impact_on_outputs: accountability_selection_frame_v1.csv contains three research-only USN00-style frames; no success-rate or universal result-ceiling claim is eligible.
requires_principal_decision: yes after W2-C populates the two search frames

original_assumption: Require every official webpage to download locally before it can be recorded.
observed_problem: The USMC and USNH official pages were readable and locatable through the web reader but returned HTTP 403 to direct archive requests.
revised_rule: Record exact URL, text locator, retrieval date and blocked archive status; do not fabricate a local artifact or downgrade the text to an unofficial source.
impact_on_outputs: W2C-SR004 and W2C-SR008 have blank artifact/hash fields and explicit blocked_403_web_observed status.
